description: Section 7 of dsnn_directionality.ipynb: held-out accuracy on the directed stochastic block model of Appendix E. Cached so the figure can be redrawn without repeating the ~45 minute run. Delete this file to force a retrain.

feature_probe.note: logistic regression on the 1-D degree feature alone

note_general: The Gen-DSNN entries were regenerated after block_inv_sqrt was changed to follow the reference implementation (detached inverse square root, degree-block jitter while training). The general family is the only one with full degree blocks and so the only one that path affects; backpropagating through eigh had been pinning it at chance. The diagonal and orthogonal entries are unchanged and were verified to reproduce exactly.
